'''This''' [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] technician was stationed in [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]] in [[3643 BBY]]. He alerted Lieutenant [[Aric Jorgan]] to [[Havoc Squad]]'s disappearance during their infiltration in the Separatist Base.
